This notebook contains the main-figure plotting code only. Statistical calculations are performed in `Visium_analyses.Rmd` and read here from saved tables.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, eval = isTRUE(params$execute), message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
source(here("R", "plotting.R"))

combined_final <- qread(here("data", "derived", "visium_scored.qs"))
epithelial <- qread(here("data", "derived", "epithelial_diffusion_map.qs"))
figure_dir <- here("results", "figures", "main")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Figure 2: multimodal atlas

```{r figure-2-umap}
p2a <- DimPlot(
  combined_final,
  reduction = "wnn.umap",
  group.by = "combined_cluster",
  cols = cluster_colors,
  label = TRUE
) + theme_void()
save_plot(p2a, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure2A_cluster_umap.pdf"), 5, 4)
```

```{r figure-2-spatial}
main_samples <- c("R3_large_3", "R3_large_4", "R2_small_1", "Pilot_small_1")
p2b <- plot_spatial_samples(
  combined_final,
  group_by = "combined_cluster",
  samples = main_samples,
  colors = cluster_colors,
  ncol = 2
)
save_plot(p2b, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure2B_spatial_clusters.pdf"), 8, 6)
```

```{r figure-2-markers}
rna_markers <- c(
  "LGR5","ASCL2","OLFM4","AXIN2","EPHB2", "ALDH1A1", "ALCAM",     # stemness
  "MKI67","TOP2A", "PCNA",              # proliferation
  "CDKN1A","CDKN2B","TP53", "GLB1", "CXCL1",    # senescence / stress
  "SLC26A3","CA2","CLCA1","TFF3","CEACAM7",  # normal/differentiated epithelium
  "COL3A1","DES","GREM1",        # stromal
  "TRAC","MS4A1", "PTPRC"        # immune
)
DefaultAssay(combined_final) <- "Spatial"
p2c_rna <- DotPlot(combined_final, features = rna_markers, group.by = "combined_cluster") +
  RotatedAxis() + theme_classic() + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

adt_markers <- c(
  "ADT-EPCAM", "ADT-PECAM1", "ADT-VIM", "ADT-ACTA2", "ADT-PTPRC",
  "ADT-CD3E", "ADT-CD4", "ADT-CD8A", "ADT-CD19", "ADT-MS4A1",
  "ADT-CD68", "ADT-CD163", "ADT-PDCD1", "ADT-CD274"
)
DefaultAssay(combined_final) <- "ADT_dsb"
p2c_adt <- DotPlot(combined_final, features = adt_markers, group.by = "combined_cluster") +
  RotatedAxis() + theme_classic() + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
save_plot(p2c_rna, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure2C_RNA_markers.pdf"), 8, 5)
save_plot(p2c_adt, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure2C_ADT_markers.pdf"), 8, 5)
```

```{r figure-2-cell-cycle}
cell_cycle <- combined_final@meta.data |>
  count(Sample_ID, combined_cluster, Phase) |>
  group_by(Sample_ID, combined_cluster) |>
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()
p2d <- ggplot(cell_cycle, aes(combined_cluster, proportion, fill = Phase)) +
  geom_col() + theme_classic() + labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Spot fraction")
save_plot(p2d, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure2_cell_cycle.pdf"), 6, 4)
```

# Figure 3: epithelial states and trajectories

```{r figure-3-diffusion}
p3a <- DimPlot(
  epithelial,
  reduction = "diffmap",
  group.by = "combined_cluster",
  cols = cluster_colors
) + theme_void()

p3b <- FeaturePlot(
  epithelial,
  reduction = "diffmap",
  features = c("dpt_pseudotime", "Senepy", "Stem_Signature", "GDF15"),
  ncol = 2,
  keep.scale = "feature"
) & theme_void()
save_plot(p3a, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure3A_diffusion_clusters.pdf"), 5, 4)
save_plot(p3b, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure3B_diffusion_features.pdf"), 8, 7)
```

```{r figure-3-spatial-scores}
DefaultAssay(combined_final) <- "Spatial"
p3c <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  combined_final,
  images = c("R4_large_2", "Pilot_large_2"),
  features = c("Senepy", "Stem_Signature", "GDF15"),
  ncol = 3,
  keep.scale = "feature"
)
save_plot(p3c, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure3C_spatial_scores.pdf"), 10, 6)
```

```{r figure-3-developmental-potential}
p3d <- FeaturePlot(

  reduction = "wnn.umap",
  features = "CytoTRACE2_Score"
) + theme_void()
save_plot(p3d, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure3D_cytotrace.pdf"), 5, 4)
```

```{r figure-3-gdf15-de-overlap}
venn_data <- readRDS(here("results", "tables", "de_gdf15_venn.rds"))
p3e <- ggvenn::ggvenn(
  data = venn_data,
  show_stats = "c",
  set_name_size = 4,
  fill_color = unname(cluster_colors[c("0", "6", "8")])
)
save_plot(p3e, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure3_GDF15_DE_overlap.pdf"), 4.5, 4.5)
```

# Figure 4: spatial associations and CD8 neighborhoods

```{r figure-4-partial-correlation}
partial_spatial <- read_csv(
  here("results", "tables", "partial_spatial_correlation.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
partial_long <- partial_spatial |>
  select(Sample_ID, group, rho_before, rho_after) |>
  pivot_longer(c(rho_before, rho_after), names_to = "Adjustment", values_to = "rho") |>
  mutate(
    Adjustment = recode(Adjustment, rho_before = "Before", rho_after = "After"),
    Adjustment = factor(Adjustment, levels = c("Before", "After"))
  )
p4a <- sample_level_boxplot(partial_long, "Adjustment", "rho") +
  facet_wrap(~group) + ylab("Spatial lag Spearman rho")
save_plot(p4a, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure4A_partial_spatial_correlation.pdf"), 6, 4)
```

```{r figure-4-local-moran}
moran <- read_csv(
  here("results", "tables", "local_moran_senescence_stemness.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
p4b <- ggplot(
  filter(moran, local_bimoran_class != "Not significant"),
  aes(local_bimoran_class, fill = local_bimoran_class)
) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = moran_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Significant spots")
save_plot(p4b, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure4B_local_moran_classes.pdf"), 5, 4)
```

```{r figure-4-cd8}
cd8_region <- read_csv(here("results", "tables", "cd8_density_region.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cd8_gdf15 <- read_csv(here("results", "tables", "cd8_density_gdf15_high_low.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

cd8_region_long <- cd8_region |>
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, LargeSmall, dens_LGD, dens_Normal) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dens_LGD, dens_Normal),
    names_to = "Region",
    values_to = "Density"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Region = dplyr::recode(.data$Region, dens_LGD = "LGD", dens_Normal = "Normal"),
    Region = factor(.data$Region, levels = c("Normal", "LGD")),
    LargeSmall = factor(.data$LargeSmall, levels = c("Small", "Large"))
  )

p4c <- ggpubr::ggboxplot(
  cd8_region_long,
  x = "Region",
  y = "Density",
  facet.by = "LargeSmall",
  add = "jitter",
  width = 0.6,
  fill = "Region"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Normal = region_colors[["Normal"]], LGD = region_colors[["Low-grade"]])
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID), alpha = 0.25) +
  ylab("CD8 T cell density around GDF15-high spots") +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", paired = TRUE, label = "p.format")

cd8_gdf15_long <- cd8_gdf15 |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$dens_High), !is.na(.data$dens_Low)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Sample_ID,
    LargeSmall,
    Adenoma,
    dens_Low,
    dens_High
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dens_Low, dens_High),
    names_to = "GDF15",
    values_to = "Density"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    GDF15 = dplyr::recode(.data$GDF15, dens_Low = "GDF15-Low", dens_High = "GDF15-High"),
    GDF15 = factor(.data$GDF15, levels = c("GDF15-Low", "GDF15-High"))
  )

p4d <- ggpubr::ggboxplot(
  cd8_gdf15_long,
  x = "GDF15",
  y = "Density",
  facet.by = "Adenoma",
  add = "jitter",
  width = 0.6,
  fill = "GDF15"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("GDF15-Low" = "#0652DD", "GDF15-High" = "#ff5252")) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID), alpha = 0.25) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("CD8 neighborhood density") +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", paired = TRUE, label = "p.format")

save_plot(p4c, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure4C_CD8_region.pdf"), 4, 4)
save_plot(p4d, file.path(figure_dir, "Figure4D_CD8_GDF15.pdf"), 4, 4)
```
